body.objective: Students will be able to describe careers and studies.
body.iCan: I can describe careers and studies.
successCriteria: I can name careers and fields of study in French
I can form and use the conditionnel
I can describe what I would like to do in the future and why
body.hook: In Canada, bilingualism is an advantage in many careers, from the federal public service to health care, law, tourism and business. Being able to talk about your plans and dreams in French, using "would" and "if," is a skill you'll use in interviews, scholarships and conversations for years.

vocabulary.definition: I would love to / I would like to.

study.title: Si j'étais…
study.question: How do I talk about my future plans in French?
study.passage:
Forming the conditionnel: future stem + imparfait endings (-ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient).
• aimer → j'aimerais, tu aimerais, il aimerait, nous aimerions, vous aimeriez, ils aimeraient
• Irregular stems: être → ser- (je serais), avoir → aur- (j'aurais), faire → fer- (je ferais), aller → ir- (j'irais), vouloir → voudr- (je voudrais), pouvoir → pourr- (je pourrais)
Si + imparfait, conditionnel: Si j'avais le temps, je voyagerais. (If I had time, I would travel.)
Careers (masculine / feminine): un infirmier / une infirmière (nurse), un ingénieur / une ingénieure (engineer), un avocat / une avocate (lawyer), un enseignant / une enseignante (teacher), un médecin (doctor), un ou une journaliste.
Dialogue:
Mme Roy : Qu'est-ce que tu aimerais faire après l'école secondaire ?
Amir : J'aimerais étudier les sciences infirmières à l'université.
Mme Roy : Pourquoi ?
Amir : Parce que je voudrais aider les gens, et les infirmiers bilingues sont très recherchés. Je pourrais travailler à Edmonton ou au Nouveau-Brunswick.
Mme Roy : Et si tu ne pouvais pas devenir infirmier ?
Amir : Si je ne pouvais pas, je serais peut-être pharmacien !
English support: après l'école secondaire = after high school; très recherchés = in high demand; peut-être = maybe.
Activity: Interview three classmates: "Qu'est-ce que tu aimerais faire dans dix ans ?" and "Si tu pouvais avoir n'importe quel métier, qu'est-ce que tu ferais ?"
study.source: Original dialogue written for this lesson.
steps: Learn career vocabulary with gender forms
Form the conditionnel, including irregular stems
Read the dialogue with a partner
Interview three classmates about the future
discussion: What would Amir like to study, and why?
What does "Si je ne pouvais pas…" show about si clauses?
study.product: Write a paragraph (8–10 sentences) about what you would like to do after high school and in ten years, using at least five conditional verbs, one si clause and a reason for each choice.

examples.title: Forming
examples.problem: Conjugate travailler in the conditionnel with nous.

examples.title: Si clause
examples.problem: Say "If I had money, I would travel."
examples.answer: Si j'avais de l'argent, je voyagerais.

practice.a: Si je pouvais, j'habiterais au Québec.

practice.q: Why is French useful in Canadian careers?
practice.a: Many jobs value or require both official languages.

practice.q: Why might bilingual nurses be in demand in New Brunswick?
practice.a: It is Canada's officially bilingual province.

misconceptions: Using the masculine form for every profession
exitTicket: Form two verbs in the conditionnel.
Write one si sentence about your future.

test.title: Practice test: Describe careers and studies

items.q: The conditional of être with je is
"If I had time, I would travel" is
options: A) Si j'avais le temps, je voyagerais
B) Si j'aurais le temps, je voyagerais
C) Si j'ai le temps, je voyagerais
D) Si j'avais le temps, je voyage
items.answer: A) Si j'avais le temps, je voyagerais

items.q: How do you say "I would like to be a teacher"?

items.answer: Ser-, aur-, fer-, ir- (also voudr-, pourr-).

items.q: Write a si + imparfait + conditionnel sentence.
items.answer: Sample: Si j'étais riche, j'aiderais ma communauté.
He wants to help people, and bilingual nurses are in demand.

items.q: Give masculine and feminine forms of two professions.
Write a paragraph about your future plans using the conditionnel.
Explain the value of French in Canadian careers.
items.answer: Many jobs in government, health and business value or require bilingualism.
